title: Everyday Life
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for everyday life.

items.definition_en: the activities you usually do each day
items.example: My daily routine starts with a short walk.

items.definition_en: to stop sleeping
items.example: I wake up at seven on weekdays.

items.definition_en: a person who lives near you
items.example: Our neighbour always says hello.

items.definition_en: on most days or in most situations
items.example: I usually cook dinner at home.

title: Family
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for family.

items.definition_en: a mother or father
items.example: Each parent came to the school meeting.

items.definition_en: a person in the same family
items.example: A relative is visiting us this weekend.

items.definition_en: having a husband or wife
items.example: My sister is married and lives nearby.

items.definition_en: to develop from a child into an adult
items.example: I grew up in a small town.

title: Home
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for home.

items.definition_en: a set of rooms for living in
items.example: They rent a quiet apartment near the park.

items.definition_en: making you feel relaxed
items.example: This chair is comfortable for reading.

items.definition_en: movable objects such as tables and chairs
items.example: The apartment has simple wooden furniture.

items.definition_en: clean and arranged in order
items.example: Please keep your room tidy.

title: Food
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for food.

items.definition_en: food eaten at one time
items.example: Breakfast is my first meal of the day.

items.definition_en: recently produced or prepared
items.example: The market sells fresh fruit.

items.definition_en: one food used to make a dish
items.example: Tomato is the main ingredient in this soup.

items.definition_en: to ask for food or goods
items.example: We ordered tea and a salad.

title: Work and Study Basics
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for work and study basics.

items.definition_en: a piece of work that must be done
items.example: I finished the first task before lunch.

items.definition_en: a period of learning or teaching
items.example: Our English lesson begins at nine.

items.definition_en: to do something repeatedly to improve
items.example: I practise speaking every evening.

items.definition_en: a person you work with
items.example: My colleague helped me with the report.

title: Time and Date
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for time and date.

items.definition_en: a day from Monday to Friday
items.example: The library closes early on weekdays.

items.definition_en: an arranged time to meet someone
items.example: I have a dental appointment on Friday.

items.definition_en: before the expected time
items.example: We arrived early for the meeting.

items.definition_en: most recent before the present
items.example: I visited them last month.

title: Transport
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for transport.

items.definition_en: travel from one place to another
items.example: The train journey takes two hours.

items.definition_en: a place where trains or buses stop
items.example: Meet me outside the bus station.

items.definition_en: a document that permits travel or entry
items.example: I bought a return ticket online.

items.definition_en: to reach a place
items.example: The bus arrives at half past eight.

title: Health Basics
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for health basics.

items.definition_en: in good physical or mental condition
items.example: Walking every day is a healthy habit.

items.definition_en: an unpleasant physical feeling
items.example: She felt a sharp pain in her back.

items.definition_en: a substance used to treat illness
items.example: Take this medicine after meals.

items.definition_en: to relax so your body can recover
items.example: You should rest if you feel tired.

title: Common Adjectives
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for common adjectives.

items.definition_en: helping you do or achieve something
items.example: This dictionary is useful for beginners.

items.definition_en: not the same
items.example: The two answers are different.

items.definition_en: able to happen or be done
items.example: Is it possible to change the date?

items.definition_en: having great value or effect
items.example: Sleep is important for good health.

title: High-frequency Verbs
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for high-frequency verbs.

items.definition_en: to require something
items.example: We need more time to finish.

items.definition_en: to decide which thing you want
items.example: You can choose one of three courses.

items.definition_en: to make something clear
items.example: Could you explain this word again?

items.definition_en: to keep information in your mind
items.example: Remember to bring your notebook.
